what: A pausable gate that was not bit-for-bit, kept as evidence: cldfrc_fice answered by the original through a pause reached by running a hoisted copy of zm_conv_evap.
runner: pycam_zmdeep_runner (kernel unit zm_conv_evap -> unit evap, pause at cldfrc_fice)

first_difference.detector: boundary export verification (verify_boundary_exports), which stops the run at the first non-identical export

diagnosis: Reaching the pause runs the hoisted copy of zm_conv_evap's arithmetic (module pycam_zmdeep_evap) instead of the oracle object's zm_conv_evap. The two are the same Fortran text compiled with the same flags in different units; the copy does not reproduce the oracle's rounding. The same stage with zm_conv_evap itself answered through its pause (7343259) and with cldfrc_fice left native (7343260) is bit-for-bit, so the difference is the hoisted arithmetic, not the pause protocol.
consequence: cldfrc_fice stays bindable and blocked in native/pi_cam/segment_runners.yaml. No further numerical routine is hoisted; pauses inside compiled kernels need a mechanism that leaves their machine code untouched.
records_withheld: pi_cam_pausable_fice-pause_50step.json was never written (the model exited before its summary); the bfb comparison record is summarised here rather than kept.
